tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an on-chain payment/transfer against an expected recipient and amount. Returns MATCH/MISMATCH/NOT_FOUND/ERROR with on-chain evidence. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Read a wallet's decoded balance (native, USDC, or any ERC-20) pinned to a block number, with explorer evidence. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Get a transaction's status, block, timestamp, from/to, value, gas used and fee with explorer links. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: address_activity
tools.description: List recent ERC-20 transfers involving an address (bounded, newest first) with direction, decoded value, block, tx hash and explorer links. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.
